label: Performance Garage — YouthMoves
covers: CORRECTION (2026-09-19): labeled vision+text but actually runs text-only — this PPTX's LibreOffice PPTX-to-PDF conversion fails the same way firsthand-pptx's does (0 images, textTrack only). Currently a second text-only data point, not a distinct vision+text one, until PPTX conversion is fixed or this entry is replaced with a PDF/DOCX source. CORRECTION 2 (2026-09-19, session 5, REVISED after reading the source PPTX): PHASE A rule 3's worked example names this document's own three band labels ("YouthMoves at FLC", "Summer Intensive", "Student Produced Concert") because the example was written FROM this document in friction-log session 1. Two consequences, and they point in opposite directions. (a) The fixture cannot distinguish "model read the document" from "model echoed the prompt", so a grouping result here is not clean evidence either way. (b) The labels are nonetheless CORRECT: shape coordinates in ppt/slides/slide2.xml show three real horizontal bands spanning Activities -> Outputs -> Short -> Medium -> Long. So losing them IS a regression, not a de-contamination. The committed baseline is itself already wrong: it captures the bands in Activities only and uses "General" for the other four columns. Root cause is modality, not prompt — the band label is printed once, inside the leftmost (Activities) shape, and this document runs text-only, so no coordinates exist to carry it rightward. NOT A VALID TRACK-BAND FIXTURE until PPTX vision conversion works. See friction-log session 5, Finding 2 + RESOLVED.

label: Art Thru Youth — Art Thru Youth
covers: vision-only+lowleg · a 1024x768 standalone PNG, and the set's only +lowleg coverage. HISTORY: originally recorded as a case the app "correctly refuses to extract". Session 11 showed the refusal was not correct — the extraction matched the source string for string, with zero inventions, the unlabelled Outcome column correctly routed to generalOutcomes, and the source's own typo "Suport working families" preserved. The refusal came from an unconditional gate (`L && N >= 6` -> confidence low -> hard stop), which measured nothing about the extraction. Fixed 2026-09-20: low legibility now caps at partial/medium and warns instead of discarding. This entry is genuinely unstable (18/17/13 items across three runs), so it remains the best test in the set for BOTH the warning path and low-DPI recall.
